guest_bio_html: Matty Dalrymple writes supernatural suspense, including the Ann Kinnear Suspense novels and the Lizzy Ballard thrillers, and hosts The Indy Author Podcast. She published her first novel, The Sense of Death, in 2013. She also consults for authors and for professionals building a second-act career, and runs her From Expertise to Authority platform. In 2026 she began serialising her novels on Substack before publication, starting with Something Rich and Strange.
